profile_text.body:
Deere & Co. is a public company headquartered in Moline, Illinois, and trades under the ticker DE. Its website describes the business as covering agricultural, construction, and forestry machinery, along with technology and services, and it directs customers to find a John Deere dealer locally or to purchase online.

The site's own framing places technology among the categories it sells alongside machinery, but the material provided does not name specific AI products or describe an AI position. No products are tracked for the company in the data reviewed here.

On the legal side, the company's exposure is recorded in Illinois, with 290 cases counted there. No lawsuits are listed individually, and no MCP servers are recorded. The company files with the SEC under CIK 0000315189.
